type.description: Select the type of change that you're committing

enum.style: Changes that do not affect the meaning of the code (formatting, etc)
enum.refactor: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
enum.perf: A code change that improves performance
enum.test: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
enum.chore: Changes to build system, dependencies, or tooling
enum.ci: Changes to CI/CD configuration files and scripts

scope.description: What is the scope of this change (core, spell, village, etc)?

subject.description: Write a short, imperative tense description of the change

body.description: Provide a longer description of the changes

breakingBody.description: A BREAKING CHANGE commit requires a body. Please enter a longer description of the commit itself

isIssueAffected.description: Does this change affect any open issues?

issueBody.description: If issues are closed, the commit requires a body. Please enter a longer description of the commit itself
